title: Wordlist Arcade: paste a vocab list, get six playable classroom games, unlimited and account-free
user: Language, ESL and primary teachers who need a quick matching, spelling, or quiz game from this week's vocabulary and have used up Wordwall's lifetime free allowance.
job_to_be_done: Paste word-definition or word-translation pairs once and instantly play or share six original classroom game formats.
smallest_useful_product: One textarea for word and meaning pairs
Match-up, word strike, anagram, word reveal, memory pairs, and quiz race
Complete game state encoded in a shareable URL
No accounts, grading, image uploads, printables, or AI-generated content
privacy: Local-first and account-free; no ads to children and no third-party runtime tracking.
success_measure: At least 30% of generated lists opened five or more times by class link, and at least 25% of creators return with a new list within 14 days.
